hero.title: Cookie policy
hero.description: Which technologies we use on the website, why they are needed and how you can manage your settings.

paragraphs.p1: Cookies are small files that a website stores on your device. Similar technologies include local storage, pixels, tags, scripts and tools that store or retrieve information on a device or collect technical browser data.

TourLink uses or may use cookies and similar technologies so the website works correctly, remembers language or display settings, protects forms and website security, understands aggregated website usage, diagnoses technical errors and improves content and performance.

These technologies are needed for the website to function, route users correctly, maintain security, prevent abuse, remember consent settings or provide a feature requested by the user. They may include language, cookie settings, form security, anti-spam, session, hosting or routing.

TourLink may use privacy-respectful analytics to understand aggregated website usage: page views and general navigation. Analytics should be configured without advertising profiles, cross-site tracking or unnecessary collection of personal data.
paragraphs.p2: Google Search Console may also be used to understand search visibility and indexing. This is not a cookie for tracking visitors on the website in the same way as analytics scripts.

paragraphs.p1: Technical monitoring tools may collect diagnostic data: page URL, browser, device, error time and technical context needed to fix website failures or security issues. TourLink aims to configure these tools without unnecessary collection of personal data.

At launch, TourLink does not use advertising or remarketing cookies. If advertising pixels, remarketing, affiliate tracking or marketing automation are introduced later, this policy will be updated and the necessary consent settings will be added before such tools are used publicly.

You can manage cookies through browser settings, private mode, extensions, privacy tools, deleting stored cookies or the TourLink banner/settings centre if available. Blocking some cookies may affect language, form security or remembering your settings.

Where consent is required, TourLink will request it before setting non-essential cookies or similar technologies. Users should be able to refuse non-essential cookies and change their choice if the website provides such a setting.
We may update this Cookie policy when website features, analytics, monitoring, marketing tools or legal requirements change. The revised version will show a new update date.
For questions about this page or TourLink services, email info@tourlink.uz or use the contacts published on the website.
